title: Design for Startups: product, interaction and visual design for founders
summary: Garry Tan walks founders through design as a self-taught practitioner: empathy-driven product design (personas, PRDs, P0-P3 priorities), interaction design (command language, remove or chunk actions, steal proven patterns) and visual design (contrast, closeness, grid). He closes with usability testing and customer support as the feedback loop.

principles.text: Design is how it works, not just how it looks; form should follow function.
principles.quote: design is how it looks it truly is not merely how it looks it is actually also how it works

principles.text: Don't chase novelty in design; novelty is the opposite of functionality. Steal proven patterns.
principles.quote: as designers you probably shouldn't be spending too much time trying to be extremely novel because novelty is the opposite of functionality

principles.text: Start from empathy and a crisp problem statement; with no real problem, design is just art.
principles.quote: if there's no problem then there's no solution it ends up being designed for its own sake and you know design for its own sake isn't design its art

principles.text: Write personas and a prioritized spec (P0-P3) so you know what to cut; scope, quality and time are the three levers.
principles.quote: one of the most dangerous things in product development period is that if you don't have these priorities you don't know what to cut

principles.text: Use direct command language and an obvious call to action; startups can't afford the passive voice big companies get away with.
principles.quote: everything that you write needs to be direct it has to be a direct personal voice and you need the call to action be incredibly obvious

principles.text: Treat customer support as product feedback: fixing the long-tail bugs one user reports creates evangelists, and a hundred people who love you beats a thousand who like you.
principles.quote: you don't have to just throw that email in the garbage you can say oh my god that's a bug oh I'm gonna fix it and then once you do that you have an evangelist for life
